scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Would you like to enter the Monster Arena?
Currently ^FF0000{0}^000000 players
^FF0000Note:^000000 Pecos, Falcons and Carts will be lost on entry.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
您想進入怪物競技場嗎？
當前有^FF0000{0}^000000名玩家。
^FF0000注意：^000000入場後，大嘴鳥、獵鷹和手推車都會消失。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Information
scripts.translation: 瞭解規則

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Come back any time.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
歡迎隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
You must purchase a pet from the Monster Tamer to start fighting.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
您必須先從怪物馴養師那裡購買一隻寵物，才能開始戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Then talk to the Usher and tell him you would like to compete.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
然後找引座員，告訴他您想參賽。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Talk to the referee to summon your monster.
Once your monster has fought, you must talk to the Usher again and choose to spectate.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
去找裁判召喚您的魔物。
魔物戰鬥結束後，您必須再次找引座員，並選擇觀戰。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Talk to the Monster Trainer, he will ask you to heal your pet.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
去找怪物馴養師，他會讓您先治療寵物。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
To do this, click the Nurse repeatedly until it says your pet is healed.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
反覆點選護士，直到她提示您的寵物已經痊癒。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
The more monsters you kill, the more exp you get and the quicker you can upgrade.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
擊敗的魔物越多，獲得的經驗值就越多，升級也就越快。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
The stronger your monster is, the longer it will take to summon again.
scripts.translation:
[怪物競技場]
您的魔物越強，再次召喚所需的時間就越長。
